sentences.en: Mutual respect must underpin any healthy society.
sentences.zh: 任何健康的社会都必须建立在相互尊重的基础上。

sentences.en: Tom needs to underpin his house as it's subsiding.
sentences.zh: 汤姆需要加固他的房子，因为房子在下沉。

sentences.en: The new data will help underpin our argument.
sentences.zh: 新的数据将有助于支撑我们的论点。
